seasonalTasks.title: Dormant copper + oil
seasonalTasks.body: Peach leaf curl preventive — must be applied before bud swell.

seasonalTasks.title: Shuck-split cover spray
seasonalTasks.body: Brown rot + plum curculio window. Captan + insecticide tank-mix per label.

seasonalTasks.title: Summer cover sprays (10–14 d intervals)
seasonalTasks.body: Brown rot, oriental fruit moth. Adjust by trap counts.

seasonalTasks.title: Pre-harvest brown rot
seasonalTasks.body: DMI fungicide 3 wk + 7 d before harvest. Respect 3-day PHI.

seasonalTasks.title: Peach harvest window
seasonalTasks.body: Ground-color yellow-orange + slight give = pick. Refrigerate within 4 h.

notes: Standard yellow-flesh freestone peach. Bacterial spot susceptibility — copper bactericides mid-summer.
